    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_AssignResponsibilities" targetRef="Gateway_Finalization_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_AdjustCompensation" targetRef="Gateway_Finalization_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_Finalization_Join" targetRef="Task_Transition"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_Transition" targetRef="EndEvent_Promoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_EmployeePromotion"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/employee-promotion">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_EmployeePromotion" name="Employee Development and Promotion" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Roles">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IdentifyNeeds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SkillEnhancement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Transition</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Promoted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreatePlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Development_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideFeedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Development_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConsiderPromotion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="HR">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewPerformance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NotApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Finalization_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignResponsibilities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AdjustCompensation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Finalization_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed" name="Development need or career aspiration identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyNeeds" name="Identify development needs or career aspirations">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreatePlan" name="Create personal development plan with HR (training, mentorship, additional responsibilities)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Development_Split" name="Start development activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SkillEnhancement" name="Continue working on skill enhancement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Receive feedback and evaluation from supervisors">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Development_Join" name="Development activities completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsiderPromotion" name="Consider employee for promotion or new role after milestones">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewPerformance" name="Conduct formal performance review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval_Split" name="Promotion approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Finalization_Split" name="Finalize promotion">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignResponsibilities" name="Assign new responsibilities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdjustCompensation" name="Adjust compensation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Finalization_Join" name="Promotion finalized">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Transition" name="Employee transitions into new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Promoted" name="Employee promoted and transitioned into new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Promotion not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds" targetRef="Task_CreatePlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_CreatePlan" targetRef="Gateway_Development_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_Development_Split" targetRef="Task_SkillEnhancement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Development_Split" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_SkillEnhancement" targetRef="Gateway_Development_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_Development_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_Development_Join" targetRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion" targetRef="Task_ReviewPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ReviewPerformance" targetRef="Gateway_Approval_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Finalization_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${promotionApproved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${promotionApproved == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Finalization_Split" targetRef="Task_AssignResponsibilities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Finalization_Split" targetRef="Task_AdjustCompensation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_AssignResponsibilities" targetRef="Gateway_Finalization_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_AdjustCompensation" targetRef="Gateway_Finalization_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_Finalization_Join" targetRef="Task_Transition"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_Transition" targetRef="EndEvent_Promoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description names several activities that are carried out side by side, with no stated order among them, and a later step starts only after all of them are finished: Model a parallel split gateway before the group of activities, with one unconditional outgoing flow to each activity. Join the activities with a parallel join gateway, and connect one outgoing flow from that join to the later step. Do not add decision conditions to these branches, and do not chain the activities in sequence when the description does not order them.
rules.situation: the description states that an activity proceeds while another activity runs at the same time, with no stated order between the two, and a later step begins only after that concurrent period ends

rules.instruction: When the description states that a review or assessment by one party leads to an approval, that the approval itself is performed work by that party, and that the approved outcome is then carried out through several separately described actions (for example, one that changes duties and another that changes pay), each given its own sentence: Model the approval as its own task performed by the stated party, placed after the review and before the approved branch. Then model each separately described follow-up action as its own task, in the order or concurrency the description gives, after the approval. Do not leave the approval implicit in the gateway label, and do not merge the follow-up actions into one combined task.
rules.situation: the description states that a review or assessment by one party leads to an approval, that the approval itself is performed work by that party, and that the approved outcome is then carried out through several separately described actions (for example, one that changes duties and another that changes pay), each given its own sentence

rules.instruction: When the description makes a later step conditional on another party's approval or acceptance of an earlier deliverable, and it does not spell out a separate negative outcome: Model an exclusive gateway at the approval point. Give the approved flow a condition and route it to the next activity. Give a second outgoing flow with a condition for the not-approved case, leading to an end event or back to the deliverable, depending on what the description supports. Do not leave the approval as a plain sequence without a gateway.
rules.situation: the description states that a later step, such as a promotion or the finalization of a change, happens only 'if approved' by a review or check, and it does not describe a separate negative outcome

rules.instruction: When the description states that an assessment or review is followed by an outcome-dependent condition (for example 'if approved') that decides whether a later activity is carried out, and it does not describe the approval as a separate piece of work: Model an exclusive gateway directly after the review or assessment task, with one conditioned outgoing flow for each outcome. Connect the positive outcome to the activity that depends on it. Do not insert a separate approval task between the review and the gateway, so the gateway is the decision point that governs the next activity.
rules.situation: the description states that an assessment or review is followed by an outcome-dependent condition (for example 'if approved') that decides whether a later activity is carried out, and it does not describe the approval as a separate piece of work
